pricing.title: A plan for the size of your business.
pricing.lead: Pick a plan, review your invoice and activate. Your plan sets how many branches, terminals and employees you can use.
pricing.fine: Prices are in EGP. You’ll see your invoice before you pay, and your subscription activates once it’s paid.

branches.a: Yes. Add each location as a branch, organize its checkout terminals, and see stock, sales and shifts per branch. The number of branches you can add depends on your plan.

permissions.a: Yes. Invite employees by email, give each one a role — owner, manager or cashier — and choose the branches they can access. People only see the features their role allows.

walkIn.q: Can I sell without registering a customer?
walkIn.a: Yes. Walk-in sales don’t need a customer. When you want to link a sale to someone, find them by phone number or add their details.

returns.q: How do returns and refunds work?
returns.a: Items are returned against their original sale. Vendora calculates the refund from the original prices, discounts and taxes, records each item’s condition and whether it can be restocked, and records the refund payment made by an authorized employee.

lowStock.a: Yes. Vendora identifies items running low at each branch, sends low-stock alerts in the app and includes them in the low-stock report.

renewal.a: Your subscription follows the plan you choose. Invoices are available in your account, and you renew by paying your renewal invoice. What you can use — such as branches, terminals and employees — follows your plan’s limits.
